source: make a game that has a beautiful map with a lobby before the match starts, players spawn in the lobby and once the match starts once another match is finished and. players then spawn into a beautiful arena arcade themed where players have to do mini games and get more points per mini game they finish, whoever has the most points wins the round a d gets awarded some coins which they can use at the shop in the lobby where they can buy auras

answers.ask: How many mini-games, and what are they? Their kind decides the arena's internal layout.
answers.answer: Use three simple arcade-themed mini-games: a coin-collecting race, an obstacle-course race, and a target-hitting game. Each should be a quick round where finishing or performing well awards points.

answers.ask: How many players per round - it sets the size of both the lobby and the arena.
answers.answer: Support up to 8 players per round, keeping the lobby and arcade arena compact but comfortable.

config.genre_evidence: "players have to do mini games and get more points per mini game they finish, whoever has the most points wins the round" defines a round-based minigame layout. The "lobby" and shop are secondary hub features.
config.evidence: "lobby before the match starts," "players spawn in the lobby," then "spawn into a beautiful arena arcade themed" for "mini games"; players earn points and "whoever has the most points wins the round."
config.addendum:
LAYOUT FEATURES for this Party & Casual map. Build these as the actual structure of the space rather than as set dressing, keep them visually distinct from one another, and keep the whole layout legible in one view.

SHAPE OF THE SPACE - Lobby and Isolated Stage: A match area fully separated from the lobby so waiting players can't see in, clip in, or interfere.

INCLUDE:
- Lobby-to-Stage Transport: Clearly marked pads or gateways at the lobby edge leading to the match area.
- Leaderboard Wall: A prominent flat structural wall in the lobby, sized and framed to host a large display.
- Eliminated Players Area: Somewhere out-of-play for eliminated players to wait and watch the rest of the round.
